title: Dielectric superionic-conductor nanofibers for highly efficient multi-channel ion transport in solvent-lean PVDF-based electrolytes
title_zh: 用于少溶剂 PVDF 基电解质高效多通道离子传输的介电超离子导体纳米纤维
summary: Li, Sr-codoped hydroxyapatite nanofibers enable multi-channel ion transport in solvent-lean PVDF-based electrolytes.
summary_zh: 锂、锶共掺杂羟基磷灰石纳米纤维在少溶剂 PVDF 基电解质中实现多通道离子传输。

title: Bone‐Inspired Sustainable Hydrogel Electrolytes for Zn Metal Batteries
title_zh: 用于锌金属电池的仿骨可持续水凝胶电解质
summary: A recyclable and biodegradable bone-like Zn-HA/gelatin electrolyte enabling rapid Zn2+ transport and durable zinc-metal cycling.
summary_zh: 可回收、可生物降解的仿骨 Zn-HA／明胶电解质，实现快速锌离子传输与持久的锌金属循环。

title: Lithium Superionic Conductive Nanofiber-Reinforcing High-Performance Polymer Electrolytes for Solid-State Batteries
title_zh: 锂超离子导电纳米纤维增强的高性能固态电池聚合物电解质
summary: Ultralong Li-HA-F nanofibers create continuous dual-conductive pathways, strengthening polymer electrolytes while improving ion transport and interfacial stability.
summary_zh: 超长 Li-HA-F 纳米纤维构建连续双导电通道，在增强聚合物电解质的同时改善离子传输与界面稳定性。
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

title: An interface-enhanced continuous 2D-carbon network enabling high-performance Si anodes for Li-ion batteries
title_zh: 用于锂离子电池高性能硅负极的界面增强型连续二维碳网络
summary: A gelatin-derived 2D carbon network improves electrical transport, lithium-ion diffusion, and structural stability in high-capacity silicon anodes.
summary_zh: 明胶衍生二维碳网络改善高容量硅负极中的电子传输、锂离子扩散与结构稳定性。

title: Lithium deposition mechanism on Si and Cu substrates in the carbonate electrolyte
title_zh: 碳酸酯电解液中锂在硅和铜基底上的沉积机制
summary: Imaging, simulation, and electrochemistry reveal how substrate and current density govern lithium growth morphology and whisker formation.
summary_zh: 成像、模拟与电化学研究揭示基底和电流密度如何调控锂的生长形貌与晶须形成。

title: A Chemically Bonded Ultraconformal Layer between the Elastic Solid Electrolyte and Lithium Anode for High‐performance Lithium Metal Batteries
title_zh: 用于高性能锂金属电池的弹性固态电解质与锂负极间化学键合超共形层
summary: A conformal, chemically bonded interlayer reduces interfacial impedance and accommodates lithium-metal volume changes for stable cycling.
summary_zh: 共形化学键合中间层可降低界面阻抗并适应锂金属体积变化，实现稳定循环。
